function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

| Category | Current World‑Number 1 | Source |
|----------|------------------------|--------|
| **Men’s ATP Singles** | **Novák Djokovic** – Serbia | [ATP Official Rankings](https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles) |

If you’d like the absolute freshest numbers (they can shift after each tournament):

1. Visit the ATP site → “Rankings” tab → “Singles”.  
2. Visit the WTA site → “Rankings” section → “Singles”.  
3. Look at the very top row—those names hold the #1 spot for that week.

Feel free to let me know if you’re interested in other categories (e.g., doubles, junior, wheelchair) or historical trends!
